issue: Incomplete/invalid product can be published; missing required-content validation
actual: Created 'QA Invalid Product' with price -50 (rendered as '-$50'), no image URL, no affiliate/retailer link, no full review, and zero specifications. Only Name, Category and Short Description are enforced. The price input has no min attribute so negative values are accepted. (Rating is the only correctly bounded field: min=0/max=5 blocked a rating of 9.)
evidence: Admin list row after save: 'Tech | QA Invalid Product | -$50 | 4.5'

Create form has a single-select Category combobox (Tech Gadgets/Home Goods/Fitness). Created 'QA Smart Desk Lamp' with Home Goods; it appears on /category/home and its detail page shows category badge 'Home' only.

Clicked the QA Smart Desk Lamp card image on /category/home -> navigated to /product/qa-smart-desk-lamp showing that same product. Card image and name links both point to the same /product/{slug} URL on every card.

issue: Newly assigned tags never become tag-filter choices
actual: Created product 'QA Smart Desk Lamp' with tags 'qazephyr' and 'adjustable' (both visible on its detail page). The /products Filters panel tag list still shows only the 35 seed-derived tags (ambiance…wireless); neither 'qazephyr' nor 'adjustable' appears, so the tag cannot be selected as a filter and the product cannot be returned.
evidence: Filters > Tags list on /products contains no 'qazephyr'/'adjustable'; document body search for both strings returned false.

issue: New tags save and display but do not participate in keyword search
actual: Created 'QA Smart Desk Lamp' with new tags 'qazephyr, adjustable'. Both render as tag chips on /product/qa-smart-desk-lamp, so saving works. But searching 'QAZEPHYR' and 'qazephyr' on /products both return '0 products found'. By contrast the seeded tag 'NOISE-CANCELLING' correctly returns Sony WH-1000XM5, so tag search itself works — admin-created products are simply absent from the searchable catalog.

issue: Search misses admin-created products; result count understates catalog
actual: Case-insensitive matching works over the 9 seeded products: 'sony'->1 (name), 'LASER DUST DETECTION'->1 Dyson (brief description), 'NOISE-CANCELLING'->1 Sony (tag), each with a correct count. However the admin-created 'QA Smart Desk Lamp' is not searchable at all — searching its exact name, description words, or tags returns '0 products found'. The unfiltered count also reads '9 products found' when 10 products exist.

issue: All Products list is not the complete product list
actual: /products renders only the 9 seeded products and reports '9 products found', omitting the admin-created 'QA Smart Desk Lamp' which does exist (visible in /admin, /category/home and /product/qa-smart-desk-lamp). Each card that IS shown does expose name, category badge, price, rating value, brief review, image and a 'Buy Now' purchase link, so card content is correct — the list membership is not.

evidence: On /products (10 products): 'sony' -> '1 product found' Sony WH-1000XM5 (name); 'LASER DUST DETECTION' -> '1 product found' Dyson V15 Detect (brief description, uppercase); 'NOISE-CANCELLING' -> '1 product found' Sony (tag, uppercase); 'QAZEPHYR' -> '1 product found' QA Smart Desk Lamp (tag, uppercase). Only matching products rendered and counts matched the rendered card count each time.

Created 'QA Smart Desk Lamp' with two new tags 'qazephyr, adjustable'. Both render as tag chips on /product/qa-smart-desk-lamp, and searching 'QAZEPHYR' on /products returns exactly that product ('1 product found').

/products shows '10 products found' with 10 article cards (9 seeded + admin-created QA Smart Desk Lamp). Each card exposes category badge, price, linked name heading, brief review paragraph, an img with product alt text, a star rating with numeric value, and a 'Buy Now' link to the retailer URL.

issue: Tag-filter choice list is static and ignores tags on newly added products
actual: With 'QA Smart Desk Lamp' present in the catalog ('10 products found') and its tags 'qazephyr'/'adjustable' shown on its detail page and matchable by keyword search, the /products Filters > Tags list still offers only the 35 seed-derived tags (ambiance, android, apple, ... wireless). 'qazephyr' and 'adjustable' are absent, so the newly assigned tag can never be selected as a tag-filter choice.

evidence: /products category filter: 'Fitness' -> '3 products found', 3 cards all badged Fitness (Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton). 'Home Goods' -> '4 products found', 4 cards all badged Home (QA Smart Desk Lamp, Breville, Philips Hue, Dyson). 'All Categories' -> '10 products found'. Only Tech Gadgets/Home Goods/Fitness offered.

Switching the /products category select from Fitness to Home Goods updated the combobox label to 'Home Goods' AND swapped the grid from the 3 Fitness products to the 4 Home products, with the count changing 3->4. Header nav category links (/category/tech|home|fitness) likewise render the matching category heading and product set.

Sort options Newest/Top Rated/Price: Low to High/Price: High to Low all reorder correctly (Newest puts the just-created lamp first; Top Rated 4.9->4.2; price asc 129->2495; price desc 2495->129). Minimum Rating '4.5+ stars' cut 10 -> 8 products, excluding Philips Hue 4.4 and QA Lamp 4.2. Price Range slider dragged to $0-$2410 cut 8 -> 7, excluding Peloton $2,495.

With tags {wireless, vacuum} selected + rating>=4.5 + price<=$2410, results were exactly Dyson V15 Detect (vacuum) and Sony WH-1000XM5 (wireless) — OR across tags, each result carrying at least one selected tag. Adding category=Tech Gadgets and search='SONY' narrowed to '1 product found': Sony WH-1000XM5 (Tech, $399, 4.8, tag wireless), satisfying every active criterion simultaneously.

All criterion changes on /products (typing in the search box, category select, sort select, rating select, price slider drag, tag chip toggles) re-rendered the grid, reordered it and updated the 'N products found' counter immediately, with the URL unchanged and no navigation/reload occurring.

Admin create/edit form offers a single-select Category with exactly three options (Tech Gadgets, Home Goods, Fitness); the /products category filter offers the same three plus 'All Categories'. Every card and detail page renders exactly one category badge, and the per-category counts partition the catalog exactly: Tech 3 + Home 4 + Fitness 3 = 10 = total 'products found'.

Every card/detail 'Buy Now' is an anchor with target=_blank rel="noopener noreferrer" to a per-product external URL (sony-xm5, peloton, dyson-v15, macbook-pro, s24-ultra, philips-hue, breville, theragun, bowflex, qa-desk-lamp). Clicking Sony's Buy Now opened a new tab at https://example.com/sony-xm5 ('Example Domain') while the app tab stayed on /products. Note: seed retailer URLs are example.com placeholders rather than real retailers.

/product/this-product-does-not-exist renders 'Product Not Found' with explanatory copy and a 'Browse All Products' link, and no product fields. /category/not-a-real-category renders 'Category Not Found' with no product grid. Neither page leaks unrelated product data.

Created 'QA Smart Desk Lamp' (Home Goods) with all fields and edited seeded 'Philips Hue Starter Kit' (Home Goods) changing name->'Philips Hue Starter Kit QA', price 199->249, rating 4.4->4.1, short description, full review, image URL, affiliate link, tags, a spec value, and featured off->on. The edit form pre-populated every existing value. After save, admin list, homepage Home Goods section, /category/home, /products and /product/philips-hue-starter-kit-qa all showed the new name, $249, 4.1, new description/review/tags/spec, new image src and buyHref https://example.com/philips-hue-qa.

Edited Philips Hue tags from 'lighting, smart-home, ambiance, automation' to 'lighting, smart-home, qamood, qanewtag' (renamed ambiance->qamood, removed automation, added qanewtag). Detail page chips now read exactly lighting/smart-home/qamood/qanewtag. Keyword search 'qamood' -> '1 product found' (Philips Hue Starter Kit QA); the removed tag 'ambiance' -> '0 products found'.

issue: Complete featured set is not browsable; homepage featured collection hard-capped at 3
actual: Marking Philips Hue as featured gave 4 featured products, but "Editor's Top Picks" still rendered only 3 (Sony, Peloton, Dyson) — the newly featured product did not appear. Its 'View all' link points to /products?featured=true, but that page ignores the featured query param: it showed 'All Products' / '9 products found' including non-featured items (Samsung, MacBook, Bowflex, Theragun, Breville), and /products offers no featured filter control. So visitors can never browse the complete featured set. Toggling does affect the homepage within the 3-slot cap: after unmarking Sony, Top Picks became Peloton, Dyson, Philips Hue Starter Kit QA.

issue: No persistence — all admin additions and edits are lost on reload
actual: Product data is held only in in-memory React state; localStorage, sessionStorage and cookies are all empty (0 keys). After reloading, the created product 'QA Smart Desk Lamp' was gone from /admin and /products, and /product/philips-hue-starter-kit-qa returned 'Product Not Found'. All edits reverted to seed values: the admin list is back to the original 9 products with 'Philips Hue Starter Kit' at $199/4.4 and Sony re-marked as Featured (its featured flag had been turned off before the reload). This also silently destroyed work mid-session when the header search form did a full navigation.

evidence: Checked all 9 seeded detail pages plus the admin-created one. Each renders category badge, numeric rating, name (h1), brief description, formatted price, a 'Buy Now' retailer anchor, tag chips, a 'Key Specifications' block (5 label/value rows for every seeded product), a product image, and a 'My Review' section. E.g. Bowflex: Fitness / 4.6 / $549 / brief desc / tags weights,dumbbells,strength,home-gym / specs Weight Range, Increments, Dimensions, Sets Replaced, Warranty / buy https://example.com/bowflex.

Category assignments are apt (Sony headphones/MacBook/Galaxy = Tech; Dyson vacuum/Philips Hue lighting/Breville espresso = Home; Peloton bike/Theragun massager/Bowflex dumbbells = Fitness) and tags are topical (e.g. Dyson: vacuum, cordless, smart-home, cleaning; Theragun: recovery, massage, muscle, therapy). Category badges and tag sets on /products, /category/* and homepage cards match the values shown on each product's detail page.

Sony WH-1000XM5 reads 'Tech / $399 / 4.8 / Industry-leading noise cancellation with exceptional sound quality and all-day comfort.' identically on the homepage featured and Tech sections, /category/tech, /products and /product/sony-wh-1000xm5; the same held for all 9 seeded products across every view. Detail pages present the full review untruncated (419-462 chars, ending in complete sentences, no ellipsis) plus all 5 key specification rows, versus the one-line brief description shown on cards.
